insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Be-You-Tiful Athletics nearly doubled total sales to $374 in Week 46, up 92.8% from $194 the prior week, on 13 units. The BE SECURE Hot Yoga Towel in Dark Gray led with $228 (+100.0%), doubling units to 6 as conversion rose to 7.9%, and the BE YOU Sling & Stretch Strap added $70 (+66.7%) at a 9.3% conversion rate. Organic sales reached $166, and Wednesday, Nov 11 was the peak day at $152.

**Metrics to Watch —** PPC revenue held at $208 while ad spend rose to $463 from $417, so the extra spend did not add ad-attributed sales this week; the good news is that total sales grew 92.8% and organic sales reached $166. Sales landed mostly early in the week, with Thursday, Nov 12 and Saturday, Nov 14 at $0, and the BE YOU Yoga Mat in Black drew 44 sessions without a sale. We are concentrating ad budget on the towel and strap, which are converting, to keep orders coming in every day.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** TACoS improved sharply to 124.0% from 215.38% as total sales grew much faster than ad spend. ROAS eased to 0.45x (prior 0.50x), with $463 of spend returning $208 in PPC revenue at a 223.0% ACOS, a 0.20% ad CTR and 2.83% ad conversion. We are cutting spend on non-converting targets and moving budget to the SKUs that are already selling.

**Actions This Week —** (1) Review ad spend on the BE YOU Yoga Mat in Black (44 sessions, no sale) and shift budget to the Dark Gray Hot Yoga Towel (7.9% conversion) and the Sling & Stretch Strap (9.3% conversion). (2) Run a search-term audit and add negatives on non-converting terms, targeting ROAS back above 0.50x and ACOS below 223.0%. (3) Test new Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands ad creative to lift ad CTR above 0.20% heading into the holiday season.
